intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer a {{course}} in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded fees and placements from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
CMR School of Legal Studies vs KLE Society's Law College is a private-college LLB comparison in Bangalore. We have a 2023 placement row for CMR, and only a 2019 row for KLE.

sections.heading: CMR School of Legal Studies vs KLE Society's Law College for LLB: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose CMR School of Legal Studies if you want the more recent 2023 LLB record of ₹3 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest, and can budget for the recorded year total of ₹1.50 lakh.
Choose KLE Society's Law College if you want the lower recorded year tuition of ₹85,000, after you accept that our only KLE placement row is from 2019.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For CMR we hold ₹1.50 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for the LLB. That is a year amount, not a confirmed three-year official total.
For KLE Society's Law College we hold ₹85,000 as LLB tuition for one year. That is also a year figure, not a confirmed three-year official total, and we have not multiplied it.
Confirm the current notices on the CMR law school and klelawcollege.org sites before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: CMR has a 2023 LLB row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest. That is a historical record, not a promise.
KLE's only LLB placement row here is from 2019, with ₹5 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest. Because it is before 2020, our summary table does not treat it as a current flagship figure.
Ask both placement cells for a 2024 or 2025 report if packages matter to you.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official LLB admissions note, including any state or university process.
KLE also lists short certificate courses in intellectual property and law and medicine, which are not the LLB itself. Compare the three-year LLB rows, not those certificates.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka, so the city is the same. Visit the law campus you would join.
Both are private colleges. Campus culture, court internships and class size may still differ, so a visit is useful.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick CMR School of Legal Studies if the 2023 placement record and the recorded ₹1.50 lakh year total are acceptable.
Pick KLE Society's Law College if the recorded ₹85,000 year tuition is the priority, after you get a placement report newer than 2019.
Do not treat KLE's 2019 row as a current average.

faqs.question: What LLB fees are on record for CMR and KLE?
faqs.answer: CMR has a ₹1.50 lakh Total Fees year figure. KLE has ₹85,000 as tuition for one year. These are not confirmed three-year official totals.

faqs.question: Which college has the more recent LLB placements?
faqs.answer: CMR has a 2023 row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest. KLE's only row here is from 2019 and is too old to treat as current.

faqs.question: Is an entrance exam listed?
faqs.answer: No exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official LLB admissions process.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka, as private law colleges.

faqs.question: Does KLE offer only the LLB?
faqs.answer: KLE also lists certificate courses in intellectual property and law and medicine on this page. Those are not the three-year LLB and should not be compared as if they were.

faqs.question: Which college is cheaper on our records?
faqs.answer: KLE has the lower recorded year tuition of ₹85,000, against CMR's ₹1.50 lakh year total. Confirm both official notices before you budget.
